visual.general_description: Dual-axis line chart of serum creatinine and tacrolimus C0 by day of operation, with a table of urine output, tacrolimus dose, AST/ALT and total bilirubin below.
visual.detailed_description: A line chart sits above a four-row table sharing the x axis titled Day of operation, with ticks from -6 to 7. The legend at the top shows a dark solid line labelled Serum Cr (mg/dL) and an orange dotted line labelled Tacrolimus C0 (ng/mL). The left y axis is titled Serum Cr (mg/dL) from 0 to 6 and the right y axis is titled Tacrolimus C0 (ng/mL) from 0 to 25. The dark line is printed with data labels 2.66, 2.44 and 2.51 on the left side, then rises through 3.15 and 4.23 to 4.98 and falls through 4.74, 3.82 and 3.21 to 2.9 at the right end. The orange dotted line is printed with labels 2.9, 3.5 and 3.4 near the bottom on the left, then rises through 12.6 and 15.8 to 19.5 and falls through 13.4, 9.3 and 6.8 to 5.2 at the right end. The table below has peach-colored cells with row labels Urine output (mL), Tacrolimus dose (mg per day), AST/ALT (U/L) and Total bilirubin (mg/dL) and printed numbers under each day. No panel letters, arrows or patient identifiers are visible.
